title: かなわない
meaning_example: I can not stand the noise from ......

sections.body_text:
(I/he/she/....) can not stand..... 
 I can not stand the noise from ......
sections.body_html:
(I/he/she/....) can not stand.....
I can not stand the noise from ......

examples.reading: となりのこうじょうがうるさくてかなわない。

comments.text:
We can use kanawanai with い-adj by dropping the I at the end of the い-adj and use くて
For な-adj we drop な and use で instead...
